# Visier

> > Visier is a Workforce AI and Intelligence platform that enables organizations to make data-driven people decisions through real-time analytics, workforce planning, and AI-powered insights.

Visier provides enterprise-grade people analytics and workforce intelligence solutions for HR leaders and organizations seeking to transform talent strategy. The platform combines real-time people data with AI and GenAI capabilities to support workforce planning, budgeting, and strategic decision-making across industries.

## Key Topics

- Workforce AI
- People Analytics
- Workforce Intelligence
- Workforce Planning
- Data Integration
- GenAI & AI Agents
- Scenario Modeling
- People Data Platform
- Embedded Analytics
- Security & Governance
- HR Strategy
- Talent Acquisition
- Workforce Insights
- Data Connectors
- Strategic Planning

## Platform & Core Products

- [Real-Time People Data Platform](https://www.visier.com/platform): Core platform for real-time people and work data analytics with AI-powered insights.
- [Workforce AI and Workforce Intelligence](https://www.visier.com): Visier's homepage showcasing Workforce AI and Intelligence for workforce planning and decision-making.
- [AI, GenAI, and AI Agents](https://www.visier.com/ai): Platform capabilities showcasing AI, GenAI, and AI Agents for workforce analytics and insights.
- [Workforce Planning & Budgeting Software](https://www.visier.com/products/workforce-planning): Workforce planning and budgeting product with scenario modeling and organizational design capabilities.
- [Visier Embedded Analytics](https://www.visier.com/products/embedded-analytics): Embedded analytics product with Semantic Layer for AI-powered workforce intelligence integration.

## Integration & Security

- [Data Connectors, APIs, & Integrations](https://www.visier.com/platform/data-connectors): Integration page detailing data connectors for BambooHR, Dayforce, Greenhouse, and other HR systems.
- [Enterprise-Grade Security & Governance](https://www.visier.com/platform/security-governance): Enterprise security and governance features including encryption, access controls, and compliance standards.

## Solutions & Use Cases

- [People Analytics Solutions By Industry](https://www.visier.com/solutions/industry): Industry-specific people analytics solutions for financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, and more.
